title: Beyond Alignment: Whitening Geometry, Profile Synthesis, and Heterogeneous Ensembles for Cross-Environment WiFi Action Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.25831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-environment deployment is the central obstacle to practical WiFi sensing: a pipeline reaching 0.89+ top-1 in its training environments collapses to 0.408 under Leave-One-Domain-Out (LODO) evaluation with only K-shot labels. A ceiling analysis shows the collapse is not an alignment problem: the action signal is strong across seen environments (about 0.89 K10), environment identity is decodable from the encoder (0.965), and the failure concentrates in the encoder's extrapolation to the novel environment. A pre-registered falsification chain confirms that "align the domains" methods--training-time alignment, readout-level prototype alignment, adversarial confusion, and covariance/subspace alignment (CORAL -3.8pp, subspace -8.3pp)--degrade performance, and that source-domain statistics anti-correlate with cross-environment contribution. The effective levers lie elsewhere; we combine them into Dec-H: (i) closed-form source within-class

translated_title: 超越对齐：白化几何、轮廓合成与异构集成用于跨环境WiFi动作识别
translated_abstract: 跨环境部署是实用化WiFi感知的核心障碍：在训练环境中达到0.89以上top-1准确率的处理流水线，在仅有K-shot标签的留一域外（LODO）评估下会骤降至0.408。一项上限分析表明，这种性能崩塌并非对齐问题：动作信号在已见环境中很强（约0.89 K10），环境身份信息可以从编码器中被解码出来（0.965），而失败集中在编码器对新环境的泛化外推上。一个预先注册的证伪实验链证实，“对齐域”的方法——训练时对齐、读出层原型对齐、对抗混淆以及协方差/子空间对齐（CORAL降低3.8个百分点，子空间对齐降低8.3个百分点）——反而会损害性能，且源域统计量与跨环境贡献呈负相关。有效的手段在别处；我们将它们组合成Dec-H方法：(i) 闭式解的源域类内……
tldr: 该论文发现跨环境WiFi动作识别的性能崩塌根源在于编码器对新环境的外推失败而非域不对齐，证明对齐类方法反而有害，并提出结合白化几何、轮廓合成与异构集成的Dec-H方法作为有效解决途径。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the performance collapse in cross-environment WiFi action recognition stems from the encoder's failure to extrapolate to novel environments rather than domain misalignment—alignment methods actually degrade performance—and proposes Dec-H, which combines whitening geometry, profile synthesis, and heterogeneous ensembles as effective levers.
